name: vat.law · 01 · VAT return due alerts cron

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { customer_id: $json.customer_id, return_id: $json.return_id, alert_type: $json.alert_type, dedup_key: $json.dedup_key, trigger_date: $json.trigger_date, payload: $json.payload } }}

={{ { from: $env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL, to: $json.customer_email, subject: 'VAT return for ' + $json.customer_legal_name + ' (VRN ' + $json.customer_vrn + ') due in ' + $json.payload.days_to_due + ' days', html: '

Your VAT return for the period ' + $json.payload.period_label + ' is due on ' + $json.payload.due_date + '.

vat.law has begun preparing the return. The India QA queue is reviewing source ledgers; any regulated method-design question will be routed to your CTA partner adviser. Log into the dashboard to review the draft.

Late filing under the points-based penalty regime (live January 2023) accrues a point on each late submission. Late payment from April 2025 attracts LPP1 (3% on day 15 + 3% on day 30) and LPP2 (10% per annum from day 31).

' } }}
